name: section4_settling
purpose: Free-body settling convergence for the paper's section 4.1.

why: The load is chosen to produce this penetration, and the mass that does
so is scene dependent, so both scenes rest at the same operating
penetration without transcribed force constants.
The value exists to keep the equal-pressure plane off a voxel cell
boundary at every rung. Cell phase is remainder(delta / 2h, 1); over a
dyadic ladder delta/h is 8/3 times a power of two, and a 1/3 offset is
invariant under halving h, so the plane stays 1/3 of a cell off a
boundary at every rung -- and 1/6 off for marching cubes, whose
degeneracy sits half a cell away at delta = (2i + 1) h.
No single penetration can put marching cubes on a boundary at every
dyadic rung: halving h turns an odd multiple into an even one.
Pass --target_equilibrium_penetration 0.02 to sit deliberately on an
affine cell boundary at every dyadic rung. That is a separate
robustness axis and is not part of this ladder.

why_8: 8 mm is the only resolution between 5 and 10 that preserves the cell
phase: delta / 2h = 5/3 there, so |phase| is 1/3 for affine and 1/6
for marching cubes, identical to every dyadic rung.
7.5 mm gives 0.222, and 20/3 mm gives exactly 0 -- the plane lands on
an affine cell boundary, which is the degeneracy the whole ladder is
built to avoid. 40/7 mm also preserves phase but clusters against the
The fourth rung exists so each series has three refinement intervals

why: The closed form pins the resting penetration but says nothing about
the path taken to reach it, and the transient has no analytic answer.
A fine tetrahedral run stands in for one, as the spatula study does.
It is a reference for the trajectory only. Accuracy of the resting
penetration is measured against the closed form, not against this run.
Every run of one scene shares a duration, because the natural period
depends on the load and scene rather than on resolution, so with a
common time step and stride the samples line up exactly and no
resampling is involved. The analysis checks that rather than assuming
it.

why_15_periods: The body reaches its final penetration to within a micrometre by about
three periods, so 15 is far longer than convergence needs. It is kept
because marching cubes loses contact on the flat scene at about 9.3
periods; a shorter run would delete that finding rather than save time.
why_stride: Asking for a trajectory forces the surface view and its connected
component pass to run at every written step rather than only inside
the settled window. Striding buys that cost back. Runs compared
against each other must share both the stride and the time step.

why: Each settling run holds about 0.3 GB, so all 26 run at once on this
machine and wall time is the slowest single run rather than the sum.
This is the opposite of the disk study, which is memory bound.

runs.composition: 2 scenes x 3 representations x 4 rungs, plus 1 tet reference per scene
